proposal_rules.title: Lock Outbox Sequence After First Valid Bump
proposal_rules.hypothesis: Unexpected-write failures recur when a valid `outbox/seq.json` bump is followed by a cosmetic second write during verification.
proposal_rules.change: Add a strict outbox sequencing rule: after one successful write to `outbox/seq.json` (id increment validated by read-back), mark that path write-locked for the remainder of the task. Require all post-bump checks to be read-only and explicitly forbid formatting/newline normalization rewrites once semantic validity is confirmed.
